MI-012.evidence: adjudicated: Unlisted .129 (its other flow is cloud HTTPS) sends 5x128 B UDP burst to 192.168.1.1:10008, no reply, after window; not GRE flood/Telnet scan; discovery-like

MI-050.evidence: adjudicated: Non-IP pseudo-flow; address bytes decode (like ARP 8.6.0.1) as 802.3 len 6, LLC XID 00/01/AF 81 01 02: Wi-Fi AP layer-2 update on station association; 24 frames/91 s, no GRE flood

MI-057.evidence: adjudicated: Lab host 205.174.165.65 to .58: neither is a flood sender or a listed victim. 7 one-way proto0 pkts over 90 s (0.08/s), unlike a GRE flood stream

MI-068.evidence: adjudicated: Non-IP frames: bytes 00 06|00 01|AF 81 01 02 decode as an 802.3 LLC XID layer-2 update that an AP sends when a station associates. 43 frames, not GRE flood

MI-071.evidence: adjudicated: .171 to .163: neither is a flood sender or a listed victim. 10/2 proto0 pkts over 90 s (0.13/s), starting after the attack window ended; not flood-like

MI-072.evidence: adjudicated: Non-IP frames that decode as 802.3 LLC XID (AF 81 01 02) layer-2 updates an AP sends when a station associates. 169 frames, no reply; not GRE flood

MI-076.evidence: adjudicated: .171 is not one of the seven flood senders and .134 is not a listed victim. 2 one-way proto0 pkts in 5 ms; no flood volume

MI-077.evidence: adjudicated: .171 to .142: neither is a flood sender or a listed victim. 9 one-way proto0 pkts in 10 s (about 1/s, like ping), far below flood rate

MI-081.evidence: adjudicated: .117 to .171: neither is a flood sender or a listed victim. One proto0 request/reply in 9 ms (like ping), whereas the GRE flood is one-way and high-rate

SP-005.evidence: adjudicated: One SYN .121 to local .35:443 refused by RST, no payload; not UDP 53, neither host a listed responder; not a completed ordinary service; redirect-target role undecidable at flow level

SP-048.evidence: adjudicated: presumed victim .210 with unlisted .206, symmetric UDP 55444<->55444 keep-alive, 96/95 pkts, fixed 16/8-B payloads, ~2 pkt/s each way; LAN device chatter, not ARP/ICMP, no .89 or gateway path
